essays.title: What a few rounds of layoffs have taught me
essays.description: Layoffs stopped being an event and became a condition of the industry. Four things I have learned from sitting through more than one, written for the people who have too.

essays.title: What to do with headcount you did not ask for
essays.description: Growing a team while the industry contracts, and what to do with the headcount you did not choose. A reorg transfer, a contractor against a budget line you never saw, a req nobody asked you whether you wanted.

essays.title: You can't vibe feels
essays.description: Agentic coding can produce what it cannot judge. When the quality bar is a feeling, your intuition is the part worth sharpening.

essays.title: How I built this site with an agent workforce
essays.description: Directing coding agents like ramping a new direct report. The bar flows from you to the agent, not the other way around.
